name: io.github.sepehr071/cinematicket-mcp
title: Cinematicket Tickets
description: Read-only Cinematicket (cinematicket.org): cinemas, films, showtimes, prices, theatre, box office.

environmentVariables.name: CINEMATICKET_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the Cinematicket requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
